candidate.title: LABITCONF: your identity and your network on Nostr
candidate.practicalProblem: Gives workshop participants a guided way to connect a browser extension, mobile remote signer or temporary practice identity, then create a profile, publish a note, follow people, inspect a trust graph and archive events without writing code.

directReaderVerification.observedTitle: LABITCONF: tu identidad y tu red en Nostr | Nostr WoT
directReaderVerification.observedH1: Probá Nostr. Hacé tuya tu identidad.

mobilePairing.observedPrompt: Esperando tu aprobación en el firmante…
mobilePairing.limitation: A complete signer handshake was not attempted because it requires a separate compatible signer and user approval.

otherCompletedWork.decision: Not selected because the four-line NIP-05 rewrite is narrower than the hands-on workshop recovery and no separate reader-facing setup resource was established.

otherCompletedWork.title: Host the Nostr WoT release publisher artwork
otherCompletedWork.decision: Rejected as a supporting brand asset, not a substantive publication.

ownWorkReview.extension: No extension version or store-availability claim is made.
ownWorkReview.sdk: The merged workshop lockfiles reference the registry tarball for nostr-wot-sdk 3.0.2, but the social copy does not present the package version as a new public release. The selected claim is the live workshop behavior verified after PR #154.

deduplication.reason: The workshop is already a substantive live first-party resource. Adding verified social copy is more direct than creating a duplicate article.

supported: The LABITCONF workshop route is live.
The page offers extension, Nostr Connect and temporary practice modes.
The live Nostr Connect flow generated a QR code and nostrconnect link.
PR #154 replaced the interrupted mobile pairing path with the published signer implementation and cancellation handling.
The exact PR head passed the required hosted checks.
notMade: A complete mobile signer handshake was tested in this run.
A new extension release is available in every store.
nostr-wot-sdk 3.0.2 is announced as a new release.

linkedin.reason: This is a substantive repair to the Nostr WoT team's own interactive workshop and directly improves the remote-signer exercise for participants.

nostr.reason: The repaired workshop is directly useful to people learning Nostr identity, signing and event portability.
